from __future__ import annotations

import importlib
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import Mock

import openai
import pytest

import extraction
from core import PatientSubmission
from extraction import (
    AnticoagulationPlan,
    BloodPressure,
    Evidence,
    EXTRACTION_INSTRUCTIONS,
    PatientDocumentExtraction,
    empty_extraction,
    extract_documents,
)

NOTE_TEXT = "VITAL SIGNS: 09:05 BP 157/117, Temp 36.7 C. Hold Xarelto 2 days before surgery."
CONSULT_TEXT = "Plan: resume Xarelto 24-48 hours after surgery once hemostasis secure."


@pytest.fixture
def submission() -> PatientSubmission:
    return PatientSubmission.model_validate(
        {
            "procedure": {"procedure_type": "Elective carpal tunnel release"},
            "documents": [
                {"doc_id": "note-1", "type": "Nursing Note", "date": "2026-03-03", "text": NOTE_TEXT},
                {"doc_id": "consult-1", "type": "Cardiology", "date": "2026-02-20", "text": CONSULT_TEXT},
            ],
        }
    )


def _completed(parsed: PatientDocumentExtraction | None, output: list | None = None) -> SimpleNamespace:
    return SimpleNamespace(status="completed", output_parsed=parsed, output=output or [])


@pytest.fixture
def client(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Mock:
    mock = Mock()
    mock.responses.parse.return_value = _completed(empty_extraction())
    monkeypatch.setattr(extraction, "_client", lambda: mock)
    return mock


def _bp(doc_id: str, quote: str) -> BloodPressure:
    return BloodPressure(
        systolic=157, diastolic=117, measured_at="09:05", evidence=Evidence(doc_id=doc_id, quote=quote)
    )


def test_extraction_imports_without_api_key(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.delenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", raising=False)

    importlib.reload(extraction)


def test_request_shape(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    result = extract_documents(submission, model="test-model")

    assert not result.failed
    assert client.responses.parse.call_count == 1
    call = client.responses.parse.call_args.kwargs
    assert call["model"] == "test-model"
    assert call["temperature"] == 0
    assert call["text_format"] is PatientDocumentExtraction
    assert call["instructions"] == EXTRACTION_INSTRUCTIONS
    assert "PLANNED" in call["instructions"] and "temporary perioperative hold" in call["instructions"]
    prompt = call["input"]
    assert "note-1" in prompt and "consult-1" in prompt
    assert "Elective carpal tunnel release" in prompt
    assert "Hold Xarelto 2 days before surgery." in prompt


def test_verbatim_quote_is_kept(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    facts = empty_extraction()
    facts.blood_pressures.append(_bp("note-1", "09:05 BP 157/117"))
    client.responses.parse.return_value = _completed(facts)

    result = extract_documents(submission, model="m")

    assert len(result.facts.blood_pressures) == 1
    assert result.rejected == []


def test_altered_quote_is_rejected(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    facts = empty_extraction()
    facts.blood_pressures.append(_bp("note-1", "BP 157/110"))
    client.responses.parse.return_value = _completed(facts)

    result = extract_documents(submission, model="m")

    assert result.facts.blood_pressures == []
    assert result.rejected[0]["kind"] == "blood_pressures"
    assert "verbatim" in result.rejected[0]["reason"]


def test_unknown_doc_id_is_rejected(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    facts = empty_extraction()
    facts.blood_pressures.append(_bp("made-up", "09:05 BP 157/117"))
    client.responses.parse.return_value = _completed(facts)

    result = extract_documents(submission, model="m")

    assert result.facts.blood_pressures == []
    assert result.rejected[0]["reason"] == "unknown doc_id"


def test_quote_from_wrong_document_is_rejected(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    facts = empty_extraction()
    facts.blood_pressures.append(_bp("consult-1", "09:05 BP 157/117"))
    client.responses.parse.return_value = _completed(facts)

    result = extract_documents(submission, model="m")

    assert result.facts.blood_pressures == []


def test_bad_plan_phase_quote_is_nulled(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    facts = empty_extraction()
    facts.anticoagulation_plans.append(
        AnticoagulationPlan(
            medication="Xarelto",
            before_surgery=Evidence(doc_id="note-1", quote="Hold Xarelto 3 days before surgery."),
            after_surgery=Evidence(doc_id="consult-1", quote="resume Xarelto 24-48 hours after surgery"),
            evidence=Evidence(doc_id="consult-1", quote="Plan: resume Xarelto"),
        )
    )
    client.responses.parse.return_value = _completed(facts)

    result = extract_documents(submission, model="m")

    plan = result.facts.anticoagulation_plans[0]
    assert plan.before_surgery is None
    assert plan.after_surgery is not None
    assert result.rejected[0]["kind"] == "anticoagulation_plans.before_surgery"


def test_api_error_sets_failed(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    client.responses.parse.side_effect = openai.APIConnectionError(request=Mock())

    result = extract_documents(submission, model="m")

    assert result.failed
    assert "APIConnectionError" in (result.error or "")
    assert result.facts == empty_extraction()


def test_refusal_sets_failed(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    refusal = SimpleNamespace(
        type="message", content=[SimpleNamespace(type="refusal", refusal="I can't help with that.")]
    )
    client.responses.parse.return_value = _completed(None, output=[refusal])

    result = extract_documents(submission, model="m")

    assert result.failed
    assert "refusal" in (result.error or "")


def test_incomplete_response_sets_failed(client: Mock, submission: PatientSubmission) -> None:
    client.responses.parse.return_value = SimpleNamespace(
        status="incomplete",
        incomplete_details=SimpleNamespace(reason="max_output_tokens"),
        output_parsed=None,
        output=[],
    )

    result = extract_documents(submission, model="m")

    assert result.failed
    assert "incomplete" in (result.error or "")


def test_no_documents_skips_the_call(client: Mock) -> None:
    result = extract_documents(PatientSubmission.model_validate({"documents": []}), model="m")

    assert not result.failed
    assert client.responses.parse.call_count == 0

Step 2 is finished and all 19 tests pass against a fake OpenAI client. I haven't made a real API call yet, and nothing is committed.

**What's in [extraction.py](extraction.py):**
- **Models:** the `PatientDocumentExtraction` models from AGENTS.md, including the new `PLANNED` medication status. I also checked that the SDK converts them into a strict structured-output schema without errors.
- **Instructions (`EXTRACTION_INSTRUCTIONS`):** the model is told to extract facts only and make no decisions. Every fact needs a quote copied exactly from the document. A temporary hold before surgery stays CURRENT, with the hold instruction filed under the plan. PLANNED means a future or proposed drug. A physician signature, a consent discussion, or a form that was sent doesn't count as the patient signing.
- **`build_prompt`:** the scheduled procedure plus every document's id, type, date, author and text, sent as JSON.
- **`extract_documents`:** makes one `responses.parse` call per patient with `temperature=0`. It returns `ExtractionResult(facts, rejected, failed, error)`.
  - It counts as failed if the SDK raises an error (retries exhausted, or no API key), the response doesn't parse, the response is incomplete, or the model refuses. A failed result carries empty facts, and later steps must treat those as unknown, not absent.
  - If a patient has no documents, no API call is made.
- **`validate_extraction`:** drops any fact whose `doc_id` doesn't exist or whose quote isn't an exact substring of that document. If a plan's before- or after-surgery quote fails, only that part is set to null and the rest of the plan is kept. Every dropped item is recorded in `rejected` with the reason.

**Tests in [tests/test_extraction.py](tests/test_extraction.py)** cover:
- the request: model, `temperature=0`, response format, every document id, and the procedure;
- a verbatim quote is kept;
- a changed quote, an unknown doc id, and a quote taken from the wrong document are each rejected;
- a bad before-surgery quote is set to null;
- a connection error, a refusal and an incomplete response each mark the extraction as failed;
- no documents means no API call.

**Two small things that came up:**
- The installed openai SDK (3.37) no longer uses `httpx`, so the API-error test builds the exception with a stand-in request object.
- The import smoke test now runs in a separate Python process with `OPENAI_API_KEY` removed. Reloading the module in place had swapped out the model classes the other tests use, which made them fail.

**Not settled yet:** quote matching is strictly exact. Any real model output that changes whitespace or punctuation will be rejected, and we'll only see how often that happens in the step 7 live run.

"""Normalization, structured parsing, reconciliation, policy evaluators, and routing."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, time
import re
from typing import Literal

from core import (
    BloodPressureVital,
    Document,
    EvidenceItem,
    PatientSubmission,
    ProcedureRisk,
    TemperatureVital,
)
from extraction import Evidence, ExtractionResult

# -------------------------
# Normalization
# -------------------------

# Assumption (APPENDIX.md names no drugs): these are the anticoagulants, by generic and brand
# name. Anything else, including antiplatelets such as aspirin and clopidogrel, is not one.
ANTICOAGULANTS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "warfarin": ("warfarin", "coumadin"),
    "apixaban": ("apixaban", "eliquis"),
    "rivaroxaban": ("rivaroxaban", "xarelto"),
    "dabigatran": ("dabigatran", "pradaxa"),
    "edoxaban": ("edoxaban", "savaysa"),
    "enoxaparin": ("enoxaparin", "lovenox"),
    "heparin": ("heparin",),
}

LAB_ALIASES: dict[str, str] = {"CBC": "CBC", "LAB-CBC": "CBC", "CMP": "CMP", "LAB-CMP": "CMP"}

_DATETIME_FORMATS = ("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M")
_DATE_FORMATS = ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%m/%d/%y", "%B %d, %Y", "%b %d, %Y")
_TIME_OF_DAY = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*([AaPp][Mm])?$")


def parse_when(value: str | None) -> tuple[datetime, bool] | None:
    """Parse a date or date/time string; returns (naive datetime, has_time).

    Timezones are dropped: all times are treated as the clinic's local time.
    """

    if not value:
        return None
    text = value.strip().removesuffix("Z")
    text = re.sub(r"([+-]\d{2}:\d{2}|\.\d+)$", "", text)
    for fmt in _DATETIME_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt), True
        except ValueError:
            pass
    for fmt in _DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt), False
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return None


def parse_date(value: str | None) -> date | None:
    parsed = parse_when(value)
    return parsed[0].date() if parsed else None


def parse_time_of_day(value: str | None) -> time | None:
    match = _TIME_OF_DAY.match((value or "").strip())
    if not match:
        return None
    hour, minute, meridiem = int(match[1]), int(match[2]), (match[3] or "").lower()
    if meridiem == "pm" and hour < 12:
        hour += 12
    if meridiem == "am" and hour == 12:
        hour = 0
    if hour > 23 or minute > 59:
        return None
    return time(hour, minute)


def to_f(value: float, unit: Literal["C", "F"]) -> float:
    """Fahrenheit, unrounded, so threshold comparisons stay exact."""

    return value * 9 / 5 + 32 if unit == "C" else value


def canonical_anticoagulant(name: str | None) -> str | None:
    tokens = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", (name or "").lower()))
    for canonical, aliases in ANTICOAGULANTS.items():
        if tokens.intersection(aliases):
            return canonical
    return None


# -------------------------
# Internal evidence model
# -------------------------


@dataclass
class Vital:
    kind: Literal["BP", "TEMP"]
    at: datetime | None
    has_time: bool
    time_source: Literal["structured", "text", "text_date", "doc_date+text_time", "doc_date", "none"]
    evidence: EvidenceItem
    systolic: float | None = None
    diastolic: float | None = None
    temp_f: float | None = None


@dataclass
class Lab:
    test: Literal["CBC", "CMP"]
    at: date | None
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class MedStatement:
    """A status statement about an anticoagulant, from the med list or a document."""

    canonical: str
    status: Literal["CURRENT", "STOPPED", "HISTORICAL", "PLANNED", "UNCERTAIN"]
    as_of: date | None  # None for structured entries, which carry no date.
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class HistoryPhysicalFact:
    status: Literal["COMPLETED", "PENDING", "MISSING", "UNCERTAIN"]
    at: date | None
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class ConsentFact:
    status: Literal["SIGNED", "UNSIGNED", "PENDING", "MISSING", "UNCERTAIN"]
    signer: Literal["PATIENT", "OTHER", "UNKNOWN"]
    matches_scheduled_procedure: bool | None
    signed_at: date | None
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class PlanFact:
    canonical: str | None
    before_surgery: EvidenceItem | None
    after_surgery: EvidenceItem | None
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class EvidenceBundle:
    procedure_date: date | None
    procedure_risk: ProcedureRisk | None
    procedure_type: str | None
    procedure_evidence: EvidenceItem
    vitals: list[Vital] = field(default_factory=list)
    labs: list[Lab] = field(default_factory=list)
    meds: list[MedStatement] = field(default_factory=list)
    history_physicals: list[HistoryPhysicalFact] = field(default_factory=list)
    consents: list[ConsentFact] = field(default_factory=list)
    plans: list[PlanFact] = field(default_factory=list)
    extraction_failed: bool = False
    extraction_error: str | None = None


# -------------------------
# Structured parsing + merge
# -------------------------


def _fmt(number: float) -> str:
    return f"{number:g}"


def _structured(path: str, value: str) -> EvidenceItem:
    return EvidenceItem(source="structured", path=path, value=value)


def _document(evidence: Evidence, docs: dict[str, Document], value: str | None = None) -> EvidenceItem:
    doc = docs.get(evidence.doc_id)
    return EvidenceItem(
        source="document",
        doc_id=evidence.doc_id,
        doc_type=doc.type if doc else None,
        doc_date=doc.date if doc else None,
        quote=evidence.quote,
        value=value,
    )


def _document_time(
    measured_at: str | None, doc: Document | None
) -> tuple[datetime | None, bool, str]:
    """Explicit text date/time, else document date + text time of day, else document date."""

    explicit = parse_when(measured_at)
    if explicit:
        return explicit[0], explicit[1], "text" if explicit[1] else "text_date"
    doc_date = parse_date(doc.date if doc else None)
    time_of_day = parse_time_of_day(measured_at)
    if doc_date and time_of_day:
        return datetime.combine(doc_date, time_of_day), True, "doc_date+text_time"
    if doc_date:
        return datetime.combine(doc_date, time()), False, "doc_date"
    return None, False, "none"


def _structured_vitals(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[Vital]:
    vitals: list[Vital] = []
    for i, vital in enumerate(submission.vitals):
        when = parse_when(vital.date)
        at, has_time = (when[0], when[1]) if when else (None, False)
        path = f"vitals[{i}]"
        if isinstance(vital, BloodPressureVital) and vital.systolic is not None and vital.diastolic is not None:
            value = f"{_fmt(vital.systolic)}/{_fmt(vital.diastolic)} mmHg at {vital.date}"
            vitals.append(
                Vital("BP", at, has_time, "structured", _structured(path, value),
                      systolic=float(vital.systolic), diastolic=float(vital.diastolic))
            )
        elif isinstance(vital, TemperatureVital) and vital.value_f is not None:
            value = f"{_fmt(vital.value_f)} F at {vital.date}"
            vitals.append(
                Vital("TEMP", at, has_time, "structured", _structured(path, value), temp_f=float(vital.value_f))
            )
    return vitals


def _structured_labs(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[Lab]:
    labs: list[Lab] = []
    for i, lab in enumerate(submission.labs):
        test = LAB_ALIASES.get((lab.code or "").strip().upper())
        if test is None or (lab.status or "").lower() == "entered-in-error":
            continue
        value = f"{lab.code} ({lab.display}) {lab.status} at {lab.effective_at}"
        labs.append(Lab(test, parse_date(lab.effective_at), _structured(f"labs[{i}]", value)))
    return labs


def _structured_meds(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[MedStatement]:
    meds: list[MedStatement] = []
    for i, med in enumerate(submission.medications):
        canonical = canonical_anticoagulant(med.name)
        if canonical is None:
            continue
        status = {True: "CURRENT", False: "STOPPED", None: "UNCERTAIN"}[med.active]
        evidence = _structured(f"medications[{i}]", f"{med.name} (active={med.active})")
        meds.append(MedStatement(canonical, status, None, evidence))
    return meds


def build_evidence(submission: PatientSubmission, extraction: ExtractionResult) -> EvidenceBundle:
    """Merge structured fields and validated document facts, keeping provenance."""

    procedure = submission.procedure
    docs = {doc.doc_id: doc for doc in submission.documents if doc.doc_id}
    bundle = EvidenceBundle(
        procedure_date=parse_date(procedure.procedure_date if procedure else None),
        procedure_risk=procedure.procedure_risk if procedure else None,
        procedure_type=procedure.procedure_type if procedure else None,
        procedure_evidence=_structured(
            "procedure",
            f"{procedure.procedure_type if procedure else None}; "
            f"date={procedure.procedure_date if procedure else None}; "
            f"risk={procedure.procedure_risk if procedure else None}",
        ),
        vitals=_structured_vitals(submission),
        labs=_structured_labs(submission),
        meds=_structured_meds(submission),
        extraction_failed=extraction.failed,
        extraction_error=extraction.error,
    )

    facts = extraction.facts
    for bp in facts.blood_pressures:
        at, has_time, source = _document_time(bp.measured_at, docs.get(bp.evidence.doc_id))
        value = f"{_fmt(bp.systolic)}/{_fmt(bp.diastolic)} mmHg"
        bundle.vitals.append(
            Vital("BP", at, has_time, source, _document(bp.evidence, docs, value),
                  systolic=bp.systolic, diastolic=bp.diastolic)
        )
    for temp in facts.temperatures:
        at, has_time, source = _document_time(temp.measured_at, docs.get(temp.evidence.doc_id))
        temp_f = to_f(temp.value, temp.unit)
        value = f"{_fmt(temp.value)} {temp.unit}" + (f" ({temp_f:.1f} F)" if temp.unit == "C" else "")
        bundle.vitals.append(
            Vital("TEMP", at, has_time, source, _document(temp.evidence, docs, value), temp_f=temp_f)
        )
    for hp in facts.history_physicals:
        at = parse_date(hp.date) or (
            parse_date(docs[hp.evidence.doc_id].date) if hp.status == "COMPLETED" else None
        )
        bundle.history_physicals.append(
            HistoryPhysicalFact(hp.status, at, _document(hp.evidence, docs, f"{hp.status} {hp.date}"))
        )
    for consent in facts.surgical_consents:
        value = f"{consent.status} by {consent.signer} for {consent.procedure}"
        bundle.consents.append(
            ConsentFact(
                consent.status,
                consent.signer,
                consent.matches_scheduled_procedure,
                parse_date(consent.signed_at),
                _document(consent.evidence, docs, value),
            )
        )
    for med in facts.medications:
        canonical = canonical_anticoagulant(med.name)
        if canonical is None:
            continue
        as_of = parse_date(med.as_of) or parse_date(docs[med.evidence.doc_id].date)
        bundle.meds.append(
            MedStatement(canonical, med.status, as_of, _document(med.evidence, docs, f"{med.name}: {med.status}"))
        )
    for plan in facts.anticoagulation_plans:
        bundle.plans.append(
            PlanFact(
                canonical_anticoagulant(plan.medication),
                _document(plan.before_surgery, docs) if plan.before_surgery else None,
                _document(plan.after_surgery, docs) if plan.after_surgery else None,
                _document(plan.evidence, docs, plan.medication),
            )
        )
    return bundle

                      systolic=float(vital.systolic), diastolic=float(vital.diastolic))
            )
        elif isinstance(vital, TemperatureVital) and vital.value_f is not None:
            value = f"{_fmt(vital.value_f)} F at {vital.date}"
            vitals.append(
                Vital("TEMP", at, has_time, "structured", _structured(path, value), temp_f=float(vital.value_f))
            )
    return vitals


def _structured_labs(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[Lab]:
    labs: list[Lab] = []
    for i, lab in enumerate(submission.labs):
        test = LAB_ALIASES.get((lab.code or "").strip().upper())
        if test is None or (lab.status or "").lower() == "entered-in-error":
            continue
        value = f"{lab.code} ({lab.display}) {lab.status} at {lab.effective_at}"
        labs.append(Lab(test, parse_date(lab.effective_at), _structured(f"labs[{i}]", value)))
    return labs


def _structured_meds(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[MedStatement]:
    meds: list[MedStatement] = []
    for i, med in enumerate(submission.medications):
        canonical = canonical_anticoagulant(med.name)
        if canonical is None:
            continue
        status = {True: "CURRENT", False: "STOPPED", None: "UNCERTAIN"}[med.active]
        evidence = _structured(f"medications[{i}]", f"{med.name} (active={med.active})")
        meds.append(MedStatement(canonical, status, None, evidence))
    return meds


def build_evidence(submission: PatientSubmission, extraction: ExtractionResult) -> EvidenceBundle:
    """Merge structured fields and validated document facts, keeping provenance."""

    procedure = submission.procedure
    docs = {doc.doc_id: doc for doc in submission.documents if doc.doc_id}
    bundle = EvidenceBundle(
        procedure_date=parse_date(procedure.procedure_date if procedure else None),
        procedure_risk=procedure.procedure_risk if procedure else None,
        procedure_type=procedure.procedure_type if procedure else None,
        procedure_evidence=_structured(
            "procedure",
            f"{procedure.procedure_type if procedure else None}; "
            f"date={procedure.procedure_date if procedure else None}; "
            f"risk={procedure.procedure_risk if procedure else None}",

        vitals=_structured_vitals(submission),
        labs=_structured_labs(submission),
        meds=_structured_meds(submission),
        extraction_failed=extraction.failed,
        extraction_error=extraction.error,
    )

    for bp in facts.blood_pressures:
        at, has_time, source = _document_time(bp.measured_at, docs.get(bp.evidence.doc_id))
        value = f"{_fmt(bp.systolic)}/{_fmt(bp.diastolic)} mmHg"
        bundle.vitals.append(
            Vital("BP", at, has_time, source, _document(bp.evidence, docs, value),
                  systolic=bp.systolic, diastolic=bp.diastolic)
        )
    for temp in facts.temperatures:
        at, has_time, source = _document_time(temp.measured_at, docs.get(temp.evidence.doc_id))
        temp_f = to_f(temp.value, temp.unit)
        value = f"{_fmt(temp.value)} {temp.unit}" + (f" ({temp_f:.1f} F)" if temp.unit == "C" else "")
        bundle.vitals.append(
            Vital("TEMP", at, has_time, source, _document(temp.evidence, docs, value), temp_f=temp_f)
        )
    for hp in facts.history_physicals:
        at = parse_date(hp.date) or (
            parse_date(docs[hp.evidence.doc_id].date) if hp.status == "COMPLETED" else None
        )
        bundle.history_physicals.append(
            HistoryPhysicalFact(hp.status, at, _document(hp.evidence, docs, f"{hp.status} {hp.date}"))
        )
    for consent in facts.surgical_consents:
        value = f"{consent.status} by {consent.signer} for {consent.procedure}"
        bundle.consents.append(
            ConsentFact(
                consent.status,
                consent.signer,
                consent.matches_scheduled_procedure,
                parse_date(consent.signed_at),
                _document(consent.evidence, docs, value),
            )
        )
    for med in facts.medications:
        canonical = canonical_anticoagulant(med.name)
        if canonical is None:
            continue
        as_of = parse_date(med.as_of) or parse_date(docs[med.evidence.doc_id].date)
        bundle.meds.append(
            MedStatement(canonical, med.status, as_of, _document(med.evidence, docs, f"{med.name}: {med.status}"))
        )
    for plan in facts.anticoagulation_plans:
        bundle.plans.append(
            PlanFact(
                canonical_anticoagulant(plan.medication),
                _document(plan.before_surgery, docs) if plan.before_surgery else None,
                _document(plan.after_surgery, docs) if plan.after_surgery else None,
                _document(plan.evidence, docs, plan.medication),
            )
        )
    return bundle

"""Normalization, structured parsing, reconciliation, policy evaluators, and routing."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date, datetime, time
import re
from typing import Literal

from core import (
    BloodPressureVital,
    Document,
    EvidenceItem,
    PatientSubmission,
    ProcedureRisk,
    TemperatureVital,
)
from extraction import Evidence, ExtractionResult

# -------------------------
# Normalization
# -------------------------

# Assumption (APPENDIX.md names no drugs): these are the anticoagulants, by generic and brand
# name. Anything else, including antiplatelets such as aspirin and clopidogrel, is not one.
ANTICOAGULANTS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "warfarin": ("warfarin", "coumadin"),
    "apixaban": ("apixaban", "eliquis"),
    "rivaroxaban": ("rivaroxaban", "xarelto"),
    "dabigatran": ("dabigatran", "pradaxa"),
    "edoxaban": ("edoxaban", "savaysa"),
    "enoxaparin": ("enoxaparin", "lovenox"),
    "heparin": ("heparin",),
}

LAB_ALIASES: dict[str, str] = {"CBC": "CBC", "LAB-CBC": "CBC", "CMP": "CMP", "LAB-CMP": "CMP"}

_DATETIME_FORMATS = ("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M")
_DATE_FORMATS = ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%m/%d/%y", "%B %d, %Y", "%b %d, %Y")
_TIME_OF_DAY = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*([AaPp][Mm])?$")


def parse_when(value: str | None) -> tuple[datetime, bool] | None:
    """Parse a date or date/time string; returns (naive datetime, has_time).

    Timezones are dropped: all times are treated as the clinic's local time.
    """

    if not value:
        return None
    text = value.strip().removesuffix("Z")
    text = re.sub(r"([+-]\d{2}:\d{2}|\.\d+)$", "", text)
    for fmt in _DATETIME_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt), True
        except ValueError:
            pass
    for fmt in _DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt), False
        except ValueError:
            pass
    return None


def parse_date(value: str | None) -> date | None:
    parsed = parse_when(value)
    return parsed[0].date() if parsed else None


def parse_time_of_day(value: str | None) -> time | None:
    match = _TIME_OF_DAY.match((value or "").strip())
    if not match:
        return None
    hour, minute, meridiem = int(match[1]), int(match[2]), (match[3] or "").lower()
    if meridiem == "pm" and hour < 12:
        hour += 12
    if meridiem == "am" and hour == 12:
        hour = 0
    if hour > 23 or minute > 59:
        return None
    return time(hour, minute)


def to_f(value: float, unit: Literal["C", "F"]) -> float:
    """Fahrenheit, unrounded, so threshold comparisons stay exact."""

    return value * 9 / 5 + 32 if unit == "C" else value


def canonical_anticoagulant(name: str | None) -> str | None:
    tokens = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", (name or "").lower()))
    for canonical, aliases in ANTICOAGULANTS.items():
        if tokens.intersection(aliases):
            return canonical
    return None


# -------------------------
# Internal evidence model
# -------------------------


@dataclass
class Vital:
    kind: Literal["BP", "TEMP"]
    at: datetime | None
    has_time: bool
    time_source: Literal["structured", "text", "text_date", "doc_date+text_time", "doc_date", "none"]
    evidence: EvidenceItem
    systolic: float | None = None
    diastolic: float | None = None
    temp_f: float | None = None


@dataclass
class Lab:
    test: Literal["CBC", "CMP"]
    at: date | None
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class MedStatement:
    """A status statement about an anticoagulant, from the med list or a document."""

    canonical: str
    status: Literal["CURRENT", "STOPPED", "HISTORICAL", "PLANNED", "UNCERTAIN"]
    as_of: date | None  # None for structured entries, which carry no date.
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class HistoryPhysicalFact:
    status: Literal["COMPLETED", "PENDING", "MISSING", "UNCERTAIN"]
    at: date | None
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class ConsentFact:
    status: Literal["SIGNED", "UNSIGNED", "PENDING", "MISSING", "UNCERTAIN"]
    signer: Literal["PATIENT", "OTHER", "UNKNOWN"]
    matches_scheduled_procedure: bool | None
    signed_at: date | None
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class PlanFact:
    canonical: str | None
    before_surgery: EvidenceItem | None
    after_surgery: EvidenceItem | None
    evidence: EvidenceItem


@dataclass
class EvidenceBundle:
    procedure_date: date | None
    procedure_risk: ProcedureRisk | None
    procedure_type: str | None
    procedure_evidence: EvidenceItem
    vitals: list[Vital] = field(default_factory=list)
    labs: list[Lab] = field(default_factory=list)
    meds: list[MedStatement] = field(default_factory=list)
    history_physicals: list[HistoryPhysicalFact] = field(default_factory=list)
    consents: list[ConsentFact] = field(default_factory=list)
    plans: list[PlanFact] = field(default_factory=list)
    extraction_failed: bool = False
    extraction_error: str | None = None


# -------------------------
# Structured parsing + merge
# -------------------------


def _fmt(number: float) -> str:
    return f"{number:g}"


def _structured(path: str, value: str) -> EvidenceItem:
    return EvidenceItem(source="structured", path=path, value=value)


def _document(evidence: Evidence, docs: dict[str, Document], value: str | None = None) -> EvidenceItem:
    doc = docs.get(evidence.doc_id)
    return EvidenceItem(
        source="document",
        doc_id=evidence.doc_id,
        doc_type=doc.type if doc else None,
        doc_date=doc.date if doc else None,
        quote=evidence.quote,
        value=value,
    )


def _document_time(
    measured_at: str | None, doc: Document | None
) -> tuple[datetime | None, bool, str]:
    """Explicit text date/time, else document date + text time of day, else document date."""

    explicit = parse_when(measured_at)
    if explicit:
        return explicit[0], explicit[1], "text" if explicit[1] else "text_date"
    doc_date = parse_date(doc.date if doc else None)
    time_of_day = parse_time_of_day(measured_at)
    if doc_date and time_of_day:
        return datetime.combine(doc_date, time_of_day), True, "doc_date+text_time"
    if doc_date:
        return datetime.combine(doc_date, time()), False, "doc_date"
    return None, False, "none"


def _structured_vitals(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[Vital]:
    vitals: list[Vital] = []
    for i, vital in enumerate(submission.vitals):
        when = parse_when(vital.date)
        at, has_time = (when[0], when[1]) if when else (None, False)
        path = f"vitals[{i}]"
        if isinstance(vital, BloodPressureVital) and vital.systolic is not None and vital.diastolic is not None:

            vitals.append(
                Vital("BP", at, has_time, "structured", _structured(path, value),
                      systolic=float(vital.systolic), diastolic=float(vital.diastolic))
            )
        elif isinstance(vital, TemperatureVital) and vital.value_f is not None:
            value = f"{_fmt(vital.value_f)} F at {vital.date}"
            vitals.append(
                Vital("TEMP", at, has_time, "structured", _structured(path, value), temp_f=float(vital.value_f))
            )
    return vitals


def _structured_labs(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[Lab]:
    labs: list[Lab] = []
    for i, lab in enumerate(submission.labs):
        test = LAB_ALIASES.get((lab.code or "").strip().upper())
        if test is None or (lab.status or "").lower() == "entered-in-error":
            continue
        value = f"{lab.code} ({lab.display}) {lab.status} at {lab.effective_at}"
        labs.append(Lab(test, parse_date(lab.effective_at), _structured(f"labs[{i}]", value)))

def _structured_meds(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[MedStatement]:
    meds: list[MedStatement] = []
    for i, med in enumerate(submission.medications):
        canonical = canonical_anticoagulant(med.name)
        if canonical is None:

        evidence = _structured(f"medications[{i}]", f"{med.name} (active={med.active})")
        meds.append(MedStatement(canonical, status, None, evidence))

    """Merge structured fields and validated document facts, keeping provenance."""

    procedure = submission.procedure
    docs = {doc.doc_id: doc for doc in submission.documents if doc.doc_id}

        procedure_evidence=_structured(
            "procedure",
            f"{procedure.procedure_type if procedure else None}; "

            f"risk={procedure.procedure_risk if procedure else None}",
        ),
        vitals=_structured_vitals(submission),

    )

    facts = extraction.facts
    for bp in facts.blood_pressures:

        value = f"{_fmt(bp.systolic)}/{_fmt(bp.diastolic)} mmHg"

        bundle.vitals.append(

        )
    for hp in facts.history_physicals:

        )
    for consent in facts.surgical_consents:
        value = f"{consent.status} by {consent.signer} for {consent.procedure}"
        bundle.consents.append(
            ConsentFact(
                consent.status,

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime, time

import pytest

from core import PatientSubmission
from extraction import (
    AnticoagulationPlan,
    BloodPressure,
    Evidence,
    ExtractionResult,
    HistoryPhysical,
    Medication,
    Temperature,
    empty_extraction,
)
from rules import (
    build_evidence,
    canonical_anticoagulant,
    parse_date,
    parse_time_of_day,
    parse_when,
    to_f,
)

NOTE = "VITAL SIGNS: 09:05 BP 157/117, Temp 38.6 C. Currently taking Xarelto 20 mg."
HP = "HISTORY AND PHYSICAL: pre-op evaluation complete."


def _submission(**overrides: object) -> PatientSubmission:
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "procedure": {
            "procedure_type": "Elective hernia repair",
            "procedure_risk": "LOW",
            "procedure_date": "2026-03-10",
        },
        "vitals": [
            {"type": "blood_pressure", "systolic": 122, "diastolic": 76, "date": "2026-03-01T10:12:00Z"},
            {"type": "temperature", "value_f": 98.8, "date": "2026-03-01T10:15:00Z"},
        ],
        "labs": [
            {"id": "a", "code": "LAB-CBC", "effective_at": "2026-03-01T08:10:00Z", "status": "final"},
            {"id": "b", "code": "CBC", "effective_at": "2026-03-05T08:10:00Z", "status": "entered-in-error"},
            {"id": "c", "code": "BMP", "effective_at": "2026-03-02T08:10:00Z", "status": "final"},
            {"id": "d", "code": "CMP", "effective_at": "2026-03-02T08:10:00Z", "status": "final"},
        ],
        "medications": [
            {"name": "Aspirin EC 81 mg PO daily", "active": True},
            {"name": "Coumadin 5 mg PO daily", "active": None},
        ],
        "documents": [
            {"doc_id": "note-1", "type": "Nursing Intake", "date": "2026-03-03", "text": NOTE},
            {"doc_id": "hp-1", "type": "H&P", "date": "2026-02-20", "text": HP},
        ],
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return PatientSubmission.model_validate(payload)


def _ok(facts=None) -> ExtractionResult:
    return ExtractionResult(facts=facts or empty_extraction())


# -------------------------
# Normalization
# -------------------------


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("name", "expected"),
    [
        ("warfarin (Coumadin) 5 mg PO daily", "warfarin"),
        ("Coumadin 5 mg PO daily (INR goal 2-3)", "warfarin"),
        ("Xarelto 20 mg PO daily with evening meal", "rivaroxaban"),
        ("Eliquis 5 mg PO BID", "apixaban"),
        ("dabigatran (Pradaxa) 150 mg PO BID", "dabigatran"),
        ("edoxaban (Savaysa) 60 mg PO daily", "edoxaban"),
        ("Lovenox 40 mg SC daily", "enoxaparin"),
        ("ASA 81 mg PO daily", None),
        ("Aspirin EC 81 mg PO daily", None),
        ("clopidogrel 75 mg PO daily", None),
        (None, None),
    ],
)
def test_canonical_anticoagulant(name: str | None, expected: str | None) -> None:
    assert canonical_anticoagulant(name) == expected


def test_parse_dates_and_times() -> None:
    assert parse_when("2026-02-24T10:12:00Z") == (datetime(2026, 2, 24, 10, 12), True)
    assert parse_when("03/15/2026") == (datetime(2026, 3, 15), False)
    assert parse_date("2026-03-15") == date(2026, 3, 15)
    assert parse_date("not a date") is None
    assert parse_time_of_day("09:05") == time(9, 5)
    assert parse_time_of_day("8:30 PM") == time(20, 30)
    assert parse_time_of_day("see flowsheet") is None


def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_is_unrounded() -> None:
    assert to_f(37.9, "C") == pytest.approx(100.22)
    assert to_f(38.0, "C") == pytest.approx(100.4)
    assert to_f(98.6, "F") == 98.6


# -------------------------
# Structured parsing
# -------------------------


def test_labs_use_aliases_and_drop_invalid() -> None:
    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok())

    assert [(lab.test, lab.at) for lab in bundle.labs] == [
        ("CBC", date(2026, 3, 1)),
        ("CMP", date(2026, 3, 2)),
    ]
    assert bundle.labs[0].evidence.path == "labs[0]"


def test_structured_vitals_keep_path_and_time() -> None:
    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok())

    bp, temp = bundle.vitals
    assert (bp.kind, bp.systolic, bp.diastolic) == ("BP", 122, 76)
    assert bp.at == datetime(2026, 3, 1, 10, 12) and bp.has_time
    assert bp.evidence.source == "structured" and bp.evidence.path == "vitals[0]"
    assert (temp.kind, temp.temp_f) == ("TEMP", 98.8)


def test_structured_meds_keep_only_anticoagulants() -> None:
    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok())

    assert len(bundle.meds) == 1

            {"name": "Aspirin EC 81 mg PO daily", "active": True},
            {"name": "Coumadin 5 mg PO daily", "active": None},
        ],
        "documents": [
            {"doc_id": "note-1", "type": "Nursing Intake", "date": "2026-03-03", "text": NOTE},
            {"doc_id": "hp-1", "type": "H&P", "date": "2026-02-20", "text": HP},
        ],
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return PatientSubmission.model_validate(payload)


def _ok(facts=None) -> ExtractionResult:
    return ExtractionResult(facts=facts or empty_extraction())


# -------------------------
# Normalization
# -------------------------


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("name", "expected"),
    [
        ("warfarin (Coumadin) 5 mg PO daily", "warfarin"),
        ("Coumadin 5 mg PO daily (INR goal 2-3)", "warfarin"),
        ("Xarelto 20 mg PO daily with evening meal", "rivaroxaban"),
        ("Eliquis 5 mg PO BID", "apixaban"),
        ("dabigatran (Pradaxa) 150 mg PO BID", "dabigatran"),
        ("edoxaban (Savaysa) 60 mg PO daily", "edoxaban"),
        ("Lovenox 40 mg SC daily", "enoxaparin"),
        ("ASA 81 mg PO daily", None),
        ("Aspirin EC 81 mg PO daily", None),
        ("clopidogrel 75 mg PO daily", None),
        (None, None),
    ],
)
def test_canonical_anticoagulant(name: str | None, expected: str | None) -> None:
    assert canonical_anticoagulant(name) == expected


def test_parse_dates_and_times() -> None:
    assert parse_when("2026-02-24T10:12:00Z") == (datetime(2026, 2, 24, 10, 12), True)
    assert parse_when("03/15/2026") == (datetime(2026, 3, 15), False)
    assert parse_date("2026-03-15") == date(2026, 3, 15)
    assert parse_date("not a date") is None
    assert parse_time_of_day("09:05") == time(9, 5)
    assert parse_time_of_day("8:30 PM") == time(20, 30)
    assert parse_time_of_day("see flowsheet") is None


def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_is_unrounded() -> None:
    assert to_f(37.9, "C") == pytest.approx(100.22)
    assert to_f(38.0, "C") == pytest.approx(100.4)
    assert to_f(98.6, "F") == 98.6

# Structured parsing
# -------------------------


def test_labs_use_aliases_and_drop_invalid() -> None:
    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok())

    assert [(lab.test, lab.at) for lab in bundle.labs] == [
        ("CBC", date(2026, 3, 1)),
        ("CMP", date(2026, 3, 2)),
    ]
    assert bundle.labs[0].evidence.path == "labs[0]"


def test_structured_vitals_keep_path_and_time() -> None:
    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok())

    bp, temp = bundle.vitals
    assert (bp.kind, bp.systolic, bp.diastolic) == ("BP", 122, 76)
    assert bp.at == datetime(2026, 3, 1, 10, 12) and bp.has_time
    assert bp.evidence.source == "structured" and bp.evidence.path == "vitals[0]"
    assert (temp.kind, temp.temp_f) == ("TEMP", 98.8)


def test_structured_meds_keep_only_anticoagulants() -> None:
    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok())

    assert len(bundle.meds) == 1
    med = bundle.meds[0]
    assert (med.canonical, med.status, med.as_of) == ("warfarin", "UNCERTAIN", None)
    assert med.evidence.path == "medications[1]"


def test_procedure_fields_parsed() -> None:
    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok())
    assert bundle.procedure_date == date(2026, 3, 10)
    assert bundle.procedure_risk == "LOW"

    blank = build_evidence(_submission(procedure={"procedure_type": "x"}), _ok())
    assert blank.procedure_date is None and blank.procedure_risk is None

def test_document_vital_time_combines_doc_date_and_time_of_day() -> None:

    facts.blood_pressures.append(
        BloodPressure(systolic=157, diastolic=117, measured_at="09:05",
                      evidence=Evidence(doc_id="note-1", quote="09:05 BP 157/117"))
    )
    facts.temperatures.append(
        Temperature(value=38.6, unit="C", measured_at=None, evidence=Evidence(doc_id="note-1", quote="Temp 38.6 C"))
    )

    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok(facts))

    bp, temp = bundle.vitals[2:]
    assert bp.at == datetime(2026, 3, 3, 9, 5)
    assert bp.has_time and bp.time_source == "doc_date+text_time"
    assert bp.evidence.doc_type == "Nursing Intake" and bp.evidence.quote == "09:05 BP 157/117"
    assert temp.at == datetime(2026, 3, 3) and not temp.has_time and temp.time_source == "doc_date"
    assert temp.temp_f == pytest.approx(101.48)
    assert temp.evidence.value == "38.6 C (101.5 F)"


def test_document_vital_with_explicit_datetime() -> None:
    facts = empty_extraction()
    facts.blood_pressures.append(
        BloodPressure(systolic=157, diastolic=117, measured_at="03/02/2026 14:30",
                      evidence=Evidence(doc_id="note-1", quote="BP 157/117"))
    )

    bp = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok(facts)).vitals[-1]

    assert bp.at == datetime(2026, 3, 2, 14, 30) and bp.time_source == "text"


def test_document_meds_and_plans_are_canonicalized() -> None:
    facts = empty_extraction()
    facts.medications.append(
        Medication(name="Xarelto 20 mg", status="CURRENT", as_of=None,
                   evidence=Evidence(doc_id="note-1", quote="Currently taking Xarelto 20 mg."))
    )
    facts.medications.append(
        Medication(name="aspirin", status="CURRENT", as_of=None, evidence=Evidence(doc_id="note-1", quote="Temp"))
    )
    facts.anticoagulation_plans.append(
        AnticoagulationPlan(medication="Xarelto", before_surgery=None, after_surgery=None,
                            evidence=Evidence(doc_id="note-1", quote="Xarelto"))
    )

    bundle = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok(facts))

    doc_med = bundle.meds[-1]
    assert (doc_med.canonical, doc_med.status, doc_med.as_of) == ("rivaroxaban", "CURRENT", date(2026, 3, 3))
    assert len(bundle.meds) == 2  # structured Coumadin + document Xarelto; aspirin dropped.
    assert bundle.plans[0].canonical == "rivaroxaban"


def test_completed_hp_falls_back_to_document_date() -> None:
    facts = empty_extraction()
    facts.history_physicals.append(
        HistoryPhysical(status="COMPLETED", date=None, evidence=Evidence(doc_id="hp-1", quote="pre-op evaluation complete"))
    )

    hp = build_evidence(_submission(), _ok(facts)).history_physicals[0]

    assert hp.at == date(2026, 2, 20)


def test_extraction_failure_is_carried_into_bundle() -> None:
    failed = ExtractionResult(facts=empty_extraction(), failed=True, error="boom")

content.text:
Step 3 is finished and all 40 tests pass. I also ran the structured parsing over all 50 sample submissions: none crashed and every vital and lab date parsed. Nothing is committed yet.

**Normalization helpers in [rules.py](rules.py):**
- **Dates and times:** `parse_when` reads ISO, `MM/DD/YYYY` and month-name dates, and records whether a time was included. `parse_time_of_day` reads times like "09:05" or "8:30 PM".
- **Temperature:** `to_f` converts Celsius to Fahrenheit without rounding, so 38.0 °C stays exactly 100.4 °F and doesn't cross the threshold by rounding. The rounded value is used only in the text shown to the nurse.
- **Anticoagulants:** `ANTICOAGULANTS` and `canonical_anticoagulant` match generic and brand names by whole word, so "warfarin (Coumadin) 5 mg" becomes warfarin. Aspirin and clopidogrel return nothing.
- **Labs:** `LAB_ALIASES` treats CBC and LAB-CBC as the same test, and CMP and LAB-CMP likewise. BMP is ignored, and `entered-in-error` results are dropped.

**Internal model:** small dataclasses (`Vital`, `Lab`, `MedStatement`, `HistoryPhysicalFact`, `ConsentFact`, `PlanFact`) collected in an `EvidenceBundle`. The bundle also carries the procedure date, risk and type, and whether extraction failed.

**`build_evidence(submission, extraction)`:**
- **Structured data** keeps its source path, such as `vitals[0]` or `labs[2]`. Medications are kept only if they're anticoagulants: active true is CURRENT, false is STOPPED, and blank is UNCERTAIN.
- **Document facts** keep the document's id, type and date and the exact quote. A document vital's time comes from, in order:
  1. a full date and time stated in the text;
  2. a date stated in the text;
  3. the document date plus a time of day from the text;
  4. the document date alone, marked as having no time.

  Which of these was used is recorded on each reading.
- **Medication statements** found in documents are kept only for anticoagulants. They're dated from their stated date, or else the document date. Plans are matched to drugs through the same alias table.

**Assumptions I made that you should check:**
- Timezones are dropped, so structured `...Z` timestamps and the clock times written in notes are compared as the same local time.
- A completed H&P with no stated date takes its document's date. I treated that as reasonable because the H&P is the document itself, unlike a vital reading inside a note.

Step 4 is finished and all 58 tests pass. As a quick check that nothing crashes, I also ran reconciliation on all 50 sample cases using only their structured data, with no LLM extraction. Nothing is committed yet.

**How the "possible latest" readings are chosen** ([rules.py](rules.py)): vitals and labs use the same simple rule. Each record covers a window of time:

- **Exact time:** a reading with a stated time is a single moment.
- **Date only:** a reading with a date but no time could be any time that day.
- **No date:** a record with no date could be any time at all.

A record is dropped only when another record certainly happened after it. Everything left is a candidate for the latest. In practice:

- **Rechecks:** a recheck at 08:30 beats the 08:06 arrival reading.
- **Later untimed reading:** a document reading dated 03/03 with no time beats a structured reading from 03/01.
- **Same-day ambiguity:** a reading with no time on the same day as a timed one keeps both as candidates. Step 5 will mark the vital UNKNOWN only if the candidates would lead to different outcomes.

**Functions:**
- **`latest_vital_candidates(vitals, kind)`** applies that rule to BP or temperature readings.
- **`latest_lab_candidates(labs, test, on_or_before)`** applies the same rule to CBC or CMP. It ignores results dated after the procedure. A completed lab with no date stays a candidate, so step 5 can report it instead of losing it.
- **`anticoagulant_statuses(meds)`** gives one CURRENT, STOPPED or UNKNOWN per drug, with its evidence (the deciding statement first). The rules:
  - The latest dated document statement wins. Structured medication-list entries have no date, so any dated statement overrides them.
  - Statements that disagree on the same date, or that say UNCERTAIN, give UNKNOWN.
  - PLANNED mentions are ignored entirely. A planned enoxaparin bridge doesn't put the patient on enoxaparin, and it doesn't change the status of the drug they're on.
  - A drug left off the medication list isn't treated as stopped. If a document says the patient takes it, it's CURRENT.

**Tests** in [tests/test_rules.py](tests/test_rules.py):
- **Vitals:** a later document BP beats a structured one; a recheck beats arrival; same-day ambiguity keeps both readings; filtering by vital type; empty input.
- **Labs:** the latest result on or before the procedure; an undated result stays a candidate.
- **Medications:** every status precedence case above, including hold and planned-bridge cases.

A hold before surgery still depends on the LLM labelling it CURRENT, as the prompt instructs. If the model labels a hold STOPPED anyway, nothing in Python catches it. The live run in step 7 will show whether that happens.

1	"""Normalization, structured parsing, reconciliation, policy evaluators, and routing."""
2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
6	from datetime import date, datetime, time
7	import re
8	from typing import Literal
9	
10	from core import (
11	    BloodPressureVital,
12	    Document,
13	    EvidenceItem,
14	    PatientSubmission,
15	    ProcedureRisk,
16	    TemperatureVital,
17	)
18	from extraction import Evidence, ExtractionResult
19	
20	# -------------------------
21	# Normalization
22	# -------------------------
23	
24	# Assumption (APPENDIX.md names no drugs): these are the anticoagulants, by generic and brand
25	# name. Anything else, including antiplatelets such as aspirin and clopidogrel, is not one.
26	ANTICOAGULANTS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
27	    "warfarin": ("warfarin", "coumadin"),
28	    "apixaban": ("apixaban", "eliquis"),
29	    "rivaroxaban": ("rivaroxaban", "xarelto"),
30	    "dabigatran": ("dabigatran", "pradaxa"),
31	    "edoxaban": ("edoxaban", "savaysa"),
32	    "enoxaparin": ("enoxaparin", "lovenox"),
33	    "heparin": ("heparin",),
34	}
35	
36	LAB_ALIASES: dict[str, str] = {"CBC": "CBC", "LAB-CBC": "CBC", "CMP": "CMP", "LAB-CMP": "CMP"}
37	# Completed result statuses (FHIR Observation); anything else (preliminary, registered,
38	# cancelled, entered-in-error, unknown, missing) is not a valid result.
39	COMPLETED_LAB_STATUSES = frozenset({"final", "amended", "corrected"})
40	
41	_DATETIME_FORMATS = ("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", "%m/%d/%Y %H:%M")
42	_DATE_FORMATS = ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%m/%d/%y", "%B %d, %Y", "%b %d, %Y")
43	_TIME_OF_DAY = re.compile(r"^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*([AaPp][Mm])?$")
44	
45	
46	def parse_when(value: str | None) -> tuple[datetime, bool] | None:
47	    """Parse a date or date/time string; returns (naive datetime, has_time).
48	
49	    Timezones are dropped: all times are treated as the clinic's local time.
50	    """
51	
52	    if not value:
53	        return None
54	    text = value.strip().removesuffix("Z")
55	    text = re.sub(r"([+-]\d{2}:\d{2}|\.\d+)$", "", text)
56	    for fmt in _DATETIME_FORMATS:
57	        try:
58	            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt), True
59	        except ValueError:
60	            pass
61	    for fmt in _DATE_FORMATS:
62	        try:
63	            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt), False
64	        except ValueError:
65	            pass
66	    return None
67	
68	
69	def parse_date(value: str | None) -> date | None:
70	    parsed = parse_when(value)
71	    return parsed[0].date() if parsed else None
72	
73	
74	def parse_time_of_day(value: str | None) -> time | None:
75	    match = _TIME_OF_DAY.match((value or "").strip())
76	    if not match:
77	        return None
78	    hour, minute, meridiem = int(match[1]), int(match[2]), (match[3] or "").lower()
79	    if meridiem == "pm" and hour < 12:
80	        hour += 12
81	    if meridiem == "am" and hour == 12:
82	        hour = 0
83	    if hour > 23 or minute > 59:
84	        return None
85	    return time(hour, minute)
86	
87	
88	def to_f(value: float, unit: Literal["C", "F"]) -> float:
89	    """Fahrenheit, unrounded, so threshold comparisons stay exact."""
90	
91	    return value * 9 / 5 + 32 if unit == "C" else value
92	
93	
94	def canonical_anticoagulant(name: str | None) -> str | None:
95	    tokens = set(re.findall(r"[a-z]+", (name or "").lower()))
96	    for canonical, aliases in ANTICOAGULANTS.items():
97	        if tokens.intersection(aliases):
98	            return canonical
99	    return None
100	
101	
102	# -------------------------
103	# Internal evidence model
104	# -------------------------
105	
106	
107	@dataclass
108	class Vital:
109	    kind: Literal["BP", "TEMP"]
110	    at: datetime | None
111	    has_time: bool
112	    time_source: Literal["structured", "text", "text_date", "doc_date+text_time", "doc_date", "none"]
113	    evidence: EvidenceItem
114	    systolic: float | None = None
115	    diastolic: float | None = None
116	    temp_f: float | None = None
117	
118	
119	@dataclass
120	class Lab:
121	    test: Literal["CBC", "CMP"]
122	    at: date | None
123	    evidence: EvidenceItem
124	
125	
126	@dataclass
127	class MedStatement:
128	    """A status statement about an anticoagulant, from the med list or a document."""
129	
130	    canonical: str
131	    status: Literal["CURRENT", "STOPPED", "HISTORICAL", "PLANNED", "UNCERTAIN"]
132	    as_of: date | None  # None for structured entries, which carry no date.
133	    evidence: EvidenceItem
134	
135	
136	@dataclass
137	class HistoryPhysicalFact:
138	    status: Literal["COMPLETED", "PENDING", "MISSING", "UNCERTAIN"]
139	    at: date | None
140	    evidence: EvidenceItem
141	
142	
143	@dataclass
144	class ConsentFact:
145	    status: Literal["SIGNED", "UNSIGNED", "PENDING", "MISSING", "UNCERTAIN"]
146	    signer: Literal["PATIENT", "OTHER", "UNKNOWN"]
147	    matches_scheduled_procedure: bool | None
148	    signed_at: date | None
149	    evidence: EvidenceItem
150	
151	
152	@dataclass
153	class PlanFact:
154	    canonical: str | None
155	    before_surgery: EvidenceItem | None
156	    after_surgery: EvidenceItem | None
157	    evidence: EvidenceItem
158	
159	
160	@dataclass
161	class EvidenceBundle:
162	    procedure_date: date | None
163	    procedure_risk: ProcedureRisk | None
164	    procedure_type: str | None
165	    procedure_evidence: EvidenceItem
166	    vitals: list[Vital] = field(default_factory=list)
167	    labs: list[Lab] = field(default_factory=list)
168	    meds: list[MedStatement] = field(default_factory=list)
169	    history_physicals: list[HistoryPhysicalFact] = field(default_factory=list)
170	    consents: list[ConsentFact] = field(default_factory=list)
171	    plans: list[PlanFact] = field(default_factory=list)
172	    extraction_failed: bool = False
173	    extraction_error: str | None = None
174	    # LLM facts dropped by quote validation, kept so they never silently disappear.
175	    rejected_facts: list[dict[str, object]] = field(default_factory=list)
176	
177	
178	# -------------------------
179	# Structured parsing + merge
180	# -------------------------
181	
182	
183	def _fmt(number: float) -> str:
184	    return f"{number:g}"
185	
186	
187	def _structured(path: str, value: str) -> EvidenceItem:
188	    return EvidenceItem(source="structured", path=path, value=value)
189	
190	
191	def _document(evidence: Evidence, docs: dict[str, Document], value: str | None = None) -> EvidenceItem:
192	    doc = docs.get(evidence.doc_id)
193	    return EvidenceItem(
194	        source="document",
195	        doc_id=evidence.doc_id,
196	        doc_type=doc.type if doc else None,
197	        doc_date=doc.date if doc else None,
198	        quote=evidence.quote,
199	        value=value,
200	    )
201	
202	
203	def _document_time(
204	    measured_at: str | None, doc: Document | None
205	) -> tuple[datetime | None, bool, str]:
206	    """Explicit text date/time, else document date + text time of day, else document date."""
207	
208	    explicit = parse_when(measured_at)
209	    if explicit:
210	        return explicit[0], explicit[1], "text" if explicit[1] else "text_date"
211	    doc_date = parse_date(doc.date if doc else None)
212	    time_of_day = parse_time_of_day(measured_at)
213	    if doc_date and time_of_day:
214	        return datetime.combine(doc_date, time_of_day), True, "doc_date+text_time"
215	    if doc_date:
216	        return datetime.combine(doc_date, time()), False, "doc_date"
217	    return None, False, "none"
218	
219	
220	def _structured_vitals(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[Vital]:
221	    vitals: list[Vital] = []
222	    for i, vital in enumerate(submission.vitals):
223	        when = parse_when(vital.date)
224	        at, has_time = (when[0], when[1]) if when else (None, False)
225	        path = f"vitals[{i}]"
226	        if isinstance(vital, BloodPressureVital) and vital.systolic is not None and vital.diastolic is not None:
227	            value = f"{_fmt(vital.systolic)}/{_fmt(vital.diastolic)} mmHg at {vital.date}"
228	            vitals.append(
229	                Vital("BP", at, has_time, "structured", _structured(path, value),
230	                      systolic=float(vital.systolic), diastolic=float(vital.diastolic))
231	            )
232	        elif isinstance(vital, TemperatureVital) and vital.value_f is not None:
233	            value = f"{_fmt(vital.value_f)} F at {vital.date}"
234	            vitals.append(
235	                Vital("TEMP", at, has_time, "structured", _structured(path, value), temp_f=float(vital.value_f))
236	            )
237	    return vitals
238	
239	
240	def _structured_labs(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[Lab]:
241	    labs: list[Lab] = []
242	    for i, lab in enumerate(submission.labs):
243	        test = LAB_ALIASES.get((lab.code or "").strip().upper())
244	        if test is None or (lab.status or "").strip().lower() not in COMPLETED_LAB_STATUSES:
245	            continue
246	        value = f"{lab.code} ({lab.display}) {lab.status} at {lab.effective_at}"
247	        labs.append(Lab(test, parse_date(lab.effective_at), _structured(f"labs[{i}]", value)))
248	    return labs
249	
250	
251	def _structured_meds(submission: PatientSubmission) -> list[MedStatement]:
252	    meds: list[MedStatement] = []
253	    for i, med in enumerate(submission.medications):
254	        canonical = canonical_anticoagulant(med.name)
255	        if canonical is None:
256	            continue
257	        status = {True: "CURRENT", False: "STOPPED", None: "UNCERTAIN"}[med.active]
258	        evidence = _structured(f"medications[{i}]", f"{med.name} (active={med.active})")
259	        meds.append(MedStatement(canonical, status, None, evidence))
260	    return meds
261	
262	
263	def build_evidence(submission: PatientSubmission, extraction: ExtractionResult) -> EvidenceBundle:
264	    """Merge structured fields and validated document facts, keeping provenance."""
265	
266	    procedure = submission.procedure
267	    docs = {doc.doc_id: doc for doc in submission.documents if doc.doc_id}
268	    bundle = EvidenceBundle(
269	        procedure_date=parse_date(procedure.procedure_date if procedure else None),
270	        procedure_risk=procedure.procedure_risk if procedure else None,
271	        procedure_type=procedure.procedure_type if procedure else None,
272	        procedure_evidence=_structured(
273	            "procedure",
274	            f"{procedure.procedure_type if procedure else None}; "
275	            f"date={procedure.procedure_date if procedure else None}; "
276	            f"risk={procedure.procedure_risk if procedure else None}",
277	        ),
278	        vitals=_structured_vitals(submission),
279	        labs=_structured_labs(submission),
280	        meds=_structured_meds(submission),
281	        extraction_failed=extraction.failed,
282	        extraction_error=extraction.error,
283	        rejected_facts=list(extraction.rejected),
284	    )
285	
286	    facts = extraction.facts
287	    for bp in facts.blood_pressures:
288	        at, has_time, source = _document_time(bp.measured_at, docs.get(bp.evidence.doc_id))
289	        value = f"{_fmt(bp.systolic)}/{_fmt(bp.diastolic)} mmHg"
290	        bundle.vitals.append(
291	            Vital("BP", at, has_time, source, _document(bp.evidence, docs, value),
292	                  systolic=bp.systolic, diastolic=bp.diastolic)
293	        )
294	    for temp in facts.temperatures:
295	        at, has_time, source = _document_time(temp.measured_at, docs.get(temp.evidence.doc_id))
296	        temp_f = to_f(temp.value, temp.unit)
297	        value = f"{_fmt(temp.value)} {temp.unit}" + (f" ({temp_f:.1f} F)" if temp.unit == "C" else "")
298	        bundle.vitals.append(
299	            Vital("TEMP", at, has_time, source, _document(temp.evidence, docs, value), temp_f=temp_f)
300	        )
301	    for hp in facts.history_physicals:
302	        at = parse_date(hp.date) or (
303	            parse_date(docs[hp.evidence.doc_id].date) if hp.status == "COMPLETED" else None
304	        )
305	        bundle.history_physicals.append(
306	            HistoryPhysicalFact(hp.status, at, _document(hp.evidence, docs, f"{hp.status} {hp.date}"))
307	        )
308	    for consent in facts.surgical_consents:
309	        value = f"{consent.status} by {consent.signer} for {consent.procedure}"
310	        bundle.consents.append(
311	            ConsentFact(
312	                consent.status,
313	                consent.signer,
314	                consent.matches_scheduled_procedure,
315	                parse_date(consent.signed_at),
316	                _document(consent.evidence, docs, value),
317	            )
318	        )
319	    for med in facts.medications:
320	        canonical = canonical_anticoagulant(med.name)
321	        if canonical is None:
322	            continue
323	        as_of = parse_date(med.as_of) or parse_date(docs[med.evidence.doc_id].date)
324	        bundle.meds.append(
325	            MedStatement(canonical, med.status, as_of, _document(med.evidence, docs, f"{med.name}: {med.status}"))
326	        )
327	    for plan in facts.anticoagulation_plans:
328	        bundle.plans.append(
329	            PlanFact(
330	                canonical_anticoagulant(plan.medication),
331	                _document(plan.before_surgery, docs) if plan.before_surgery else None,
332	                _document(plan.after_surgery, docs) if plan.after_surgery else None,
333	                _document(plan.evidence, docs, plan.medication),
334	            )
335	        )
336	    return bundle
337	
338	
339	# -------------------------
340	# Reconciliation
341	# -------------------------
342	
343	
344	def _interval(at: datetime | date | None, has_time: bool) -> tuple[datetime, datetime]:
345	    """When a record could have happened: an instant, a whole day, or any time if undated."""
346	
347	    if at is None:
348	        return datetime.min, datetime.max
349	    if not isinstance(at, datetime):
350	        at = datetime.combine(at, time())
351	    if has_time:
352	        return at, at
353	    return at.replace(hour=0, minute=0), datetime.combine(at.date(), time.max)
354	
355	
356	def _possible_latest(items: list, interval) -> list:
357	    """Every item not definitely earlier than some other item. Usually a single item."""
358	
359	    spans = [interval(item) for item in items]
360	    return [
361	        item
362	        for item, (_, latest) in zip(items, spans)

376	) -> list[Lab]:

402	    """Status per anticoagulant: the latest dated statement wins over older and undated ones.
403

405	    PLANNED mentions are ignored. A drug that is never mentioned is simply absent.
406	    """
407	
408	    results: list[AnticoagulantStatus] = []
409	    for canonical in sorted({m.canonical for m in meds}):
410	        statements = [m for m in meds if m.canonical == canonical and m.status != "PLANNED"]
411	        if not statements:
412	            continue
413	        dated = [m for m in statements if m.as_of is not None]
414	        if dated:
415	            newest = max(m.as_of for m in dated)
416	            deciding = [m for m in dated if m.as_of == newest]
417	        else:
418	            deciding = statements
419	        outcomes = {_MED_STATUS[m.status] for m in deciding}
420	        status = outcomes.pop() if len(outcomes) == 1 else "UNKNOWN"
421	        older = sorted(
422	            (m for m in statements if m not in deciding),
423	            key=lambda m: m.as_of or date.min,
424	            reverse=True,
425	        )
426	        results.append(
427	            AnticoagulantStatus(canonical, status, [m.evidence for m in deciding + older])

content.text:
I compared [rules.py](rules.py) against every policy line in [APPENDIX.md](APPENDIX.md). Every threshold and outcome matches it, but one case contradicts it, and two places go further than the appendix says.

### Line by line

| APPENDIX.md says | `rules.py` does | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| **Rule 1:** H&P "completed within 30 days of the scheduled procedure date" | A COMPLETED H&P 0–30 days before the procedure passes (both ends included) | Matches; including both ends is an assumption to document |
| **Rule 1:** "Signed Surgical Consent" | Requires `SIGNED` + signer `PATIENT` + `matches_scheduled_procedure` | **Goes further** (point 2) |
| **Rule 1:** missing or outdated → NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP | FAIL, `REQUIRED_DOCUMENTATION` | Matches |
| **Rule 2:** procedure must be LOW, MODERATE or HIGH | Null risk → UNKNOWN (`MISSING_REQUIRED_DATA`) | Matches, via the missing-field clause |
| **Rule 2:** LOW/MOD: CBC ≤ 30 days; HIGH: CBC + CMP ≤ 14 days | `LAB_WINDOW_DAYS`, CMP checked only for HIGH | Matches |
| **Rule 2:** "Only the most recent result for each required test" | Latest **completed** result **on or before** the procedure | **Goes further** (point 3) |
| **Rule 2:** missing or outside window → NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP | FAIL, `REQUIRED_TESTING` | Matches |
| **Rule 3:** "currently taking anticoagulant medication" | Status CURRENT, from the hardcoded drug list | Matches; the drug list is an assumption to document |
| **Rule 3:** the plan must describe before **and** after | Both quotes must be present for the same drug | Matches |
| **Rule 3:** no plan, incomplete, or ambiguous → NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP | FAIL, `ANTICOAGULATION_MANAGEMENT` | Matches. "Ambiguous" is caught only at extraction, where the LLM leaves an unclear phase null |
| **Rule 4:** SBP ≥ 180, DBP ≥ 110, temp > 100.4 °F | `SBP_LIMIT`, `DBP_LIMIT`, `TEMP_LIMIT_F` with ≥ / ≥ / > | Matches exactly; Celsius is converted without rounding |
| **Rule 4:** most recent value; "a rechecked vital within range is sufficient" | Latest candidate wins; a recheck replaces the earlier reading | Matches |
| **Rule 4:** "at the time of pre-operative review" | Uses the latest reading, with no cutoff at the review time | Gap (point 4) |

Both changes are in [rules.py](rules.py) and all 121 tests pass. The consent and lab rules are unchanged, as you asked. Nothing is committed yet.

**Anticoagulation:** a complete plan for the drug is now checked before the drug's status.
- **Status unclear, complete plan exists:** PASS. If the patient is taking it, the plan covers it; if not, no plan is needed. The summary notes that current use is unclear but the rule is met either way. The evidence includes the plan, its before and after instructions, and the medication statements that made the status unclear.
- **Status unclear, no complete plan:** stays UNKNOWN (`MISSING_REQUIRED_DATA`). The evidence now also includes any partial plan.
- **Passing plans in general:** they now include the drug's medication evidence too, so the nurse sees why the drug counts as current.

**Extraction failures:** still UNKNOWN wherever a later reading or note might exist, but structured evidence is kept.
- **BP and temperature:** the latest structured readings stay as evidence, and the summary names the latest value. For example, a structured 190/100 shows up as UNKNOWN with "Latest structured blood pressure: 190/100".
- **Anticoagulation:** structured medication-list entries, including stopped ones, stay as evidence on the UNKNOWN finding.
- **H&P and consent:** these come only from documents, so a failed extraction leaves them no evidence to keep.

There are 4 new tests: unclear status with a complete plan passes; unclear status with an incomplete plan stays UNKNOWN and keeps the evidence; a failed extraction keeps the medication evidence; and a failed extraction keeps a high structured BP visible. I also updated one existing test for the extra medication evidence on passing plans.

"""Shared policy, schema, and prompt helpers for the pre-op triage scripts."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import AliasChoices, BaseModel, Field

# -------------------------
# Policy + system prompt
# -------------------------

BASELINE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """
You are a clinical operations assistant for pre-op scheduling triage.
Base decisions only on the policy below. General clinical knowledge may be used to interpret the record (e.g., drug brand names, unit conversions), not to add criteria.

Cadence Surgical Center Pre-Operative Scheduling Policy (effective Jan 1, 2026)

Output exactly one status:
- READY
- NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP
- NOT_CLEARED

Rule 1: Required documentation
- History and Physical (H&P) must exist and be completed within 30 days of procedure date.
- Signed Surgical Consent must exist.
If documentation is missing/outdated -> NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP.

Rule 2: Required testing by procedure risk
- LOW or MODERATE risk: CBC within 30 days of procedure date.
- HIGH risk: CBC within 14 days and CMP within 14 days.
Use only the most recent result for each required test.
If a required test is missing or outside window -> NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP.

Rule 3: Anticoagulation management
If the patient is currently taking an anticoagulant, a perioperative anticoagulation plan must be documented and clear.
If no clear plan is documented -> NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP.

Rule 4: Acute safety exclusions
If any of the following are present at review time -> NOT_CLEARED:
- Systolic BP >= 180 mmHg
- Diastolic BP >= 110 mmHg
- Temperature > 100.4 F
Use the most recent relevant vital.

Final determination
- READY only if all required criteria are satisfied and no exclusions are present.
- If a required field needed to evaluate a rule is missing/unknown -> NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP.

Output requirements
- Return exactly one JSON object.
""".strip()

Decision = Literal["READY", "NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP", "NOT_CLEARED"]
ProcedureRisk = Literal["LOW", "MODERATE", "HIGH"]
IssueCategory = Literal[
    "REQUIRED_DOCUMENTATION",
    "REQUIRED_TESTING",
    "ANTICOAGULATION_MANAGEMENT",
    "ACUTE_SAFETY_EXCLUSION",
    "MISSING_REQUIRED_DATA",
]

# -------------------------
# Schemas
# -------------------------

class PatientName(BaseModel):

# -------------------------

def _new_style_output() -> TriageOutput:
    cbc_evidence = EvidenceItem(source="structured", path="labs[0]", value="CBC 2026-01-01")
    temp_evidence = EvidenceItem(
        source="document",
        doc_id="doc-1",
        doc_type="Pre-op Nursing Intake",
        doc_date="2026-01-30",
        quote="Temp 38.6 C",
        value="38.6 C",
    )
    findings = [
        Finding(
            rule="TESTING",
            check="CBC",
            status="FAIL",
            category="REQUIRED_TESTING",
            summary="Latest CBC is 31 days before the procedure.",
            evidence=[cbc_evidence],
        ),
        Finding(
            rule="SAFETY",
            check="TEMPERATURE",
            status="FAIL",
            category="ACUTE_SAFETY_EXCLUSION",
            summary="Latest temperature 101.5 F exceeds 100.4 F.",
            evidence=[temp_evidence],
        ),
        Finding(rule="SAFETY", check="BP", status="PASS", summary="Latest BP 120/80."),
    ]
    issues = [
        TriageIssue(
            category=f.category,
            evidence=f.evidence,
            rule=f.rule,
            check=f.check,
            status=f.status,
            summary=f.summary,
        )
        for f in findings
        if f.status != "PASS" and f.category is not None
    ]
    return TriageOutput(
        decision="NOT_CLEARED",
        issues=issues,
        explanation="Fever exclusion; CBC out of window.",
        findings=findings,
    )


def test_new_style_output_validates_against_scorer() -> None:
    output = _new_style_output()

    scored = ScoredOutput.model_validate(output.model_dump())

    assert scored.decision == "NOT_CLEARED"
    assert sorted(issue.category for issue in scored.issues) == [
        "ACUTE_SAFETY_EXCLUSION",
        "REQUIRED_TESTING",
    ]


def test_new_style_output_round_trips_through_json() -> None:
    output = _new_style_output()

    restored = TriageOutput.model_validate_json(output.model_dump_json())

    assert restored == output
    assert isinstance(restored.issues[0].evidence, list)
    assert restored.issues[1].evidence[0].quote == "Temp 38.6 C"
    assert len(restored.findings) == 3


def test_baseline_style_output_still_validates() -> None:
    output = TriageOutput.model_validate(
        {
            "decision": "NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP",
            "issues": [{"category": "REQUIRED_DOCUMENTATION", "evidence": "No consent."}],
            "explanation": "Consent missing.",
        }
    )

    assert output.issues[0].evidence == "No consent."
    assert output.findings == []


def test_invalid_issue_category_is_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        TriageIssue.model_validate({"category": "SOMETHING_ELSE", "evidence": []})

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        Finding.model_validate(
            {"rule": "SAFETY", "check": "BP", "status": "FAIL", "category": "BAD", "summary": "x"}
        )

# -------------------------
# Routing
# -------------------------

from core import Finding  # noqa: E402
from rules import route  # noqa: E402


def _f(rule: str, check: str, status: str, category: str | None = None) -> Finding:
    return Finding(rule=rule, check=check, status=status, category=category, summary=f"{check} {status}.")


ALL_PASS = [
    _f("DOCUMENTATION", "H&P", "PASS"),
    _f("DOCUMENTATION", "CONSENT", "PASS"),
    _f("TESTING", "CBC", "PASS"),
    _f("ANTICOAGULATION", "ANTICOAGULANT", "PASS"),
    _f("SAFETY", "BP", "PASS"),
    _f("SAFETY", "TEMPERATURE", "PASS"),
]


def _with(*replacements: Finding) -> list[Finding]:
    by_check = {f.check: f for f in replacements}
    return [by_check.get(f.check, f) for f in ALL_PASS]


def test_all_pass_is_ready() -> None:
    output = route(ALL_PASS, _bundle())

    assert (output.decision, output.issues) == ("READY", [])
    assert len(output.findings) == 6
    assert output.explanation.startswith("Ready")


def test_safety_fail_is_not_cleared_even_with_other_issues() -> None:
    findings = _with(
        _f("SAFETY", "BP", "FAIL", "ACUTE_SAFETY_EXCLUSION"),
        _f("DOCUMENTATION", "CONSENT", "FAIL", "REQUIRED_DOCUMENTATION"),
        _f("SAFETY", "TEMPERATURE", "UNKNOWN", "MISSING_REQUIRED_DATA"),
    )

    output = route(findings, _bundle())

    assert output.decision == "NOT_CLEARED"
    assert sorted(i.category for i in output.issues) == [
        "ACUTE_SAFETY_EXCLUSION", "MISSING_REQUIRED_DATA", "REQUIRED_DOCUMENTATION",
    ]
    assert "BP FAIL." in output.explanation and "Also needs follow-up" in output.explanation


@pytest.mark.parametrize("finding", [
    _f("TESTING", "CBC", "FAIL", "REQUIRED_TESTING"),
    _f("SAFETY", "TEMPERATURE", "UNKNOWN", "MISSING_REQUIRED_DATA"),
    _f("ANTICOAGULATION", "ANTICOAGULANT", "UNKNOWN", "MISSING_REQUIRED_DATA"),
])
def test_any_fail_or_unknown_needs_follow_up(finding: Finding) -> None:
    output = route(_with(finding), _bundle())

    assert output.decision == "NEEDS_FOLLOW_UP"
    assert [(i.check, i.status, i.category) for i in output.issues] == [
        (finding.check, finding.status, finding.category)
    ]


def test_issues_map_one_to_one_with_non_pass_findings() -> None:
    findings = _with(
        _f("DOCUMENTATION", "H&P", "FAIL", "REQUIRED_DOCUMENTATION"),
        _f("DOCUMENTATION", "CONSENT", "FAIL", "REQUIRED_DOCUMENTATION"),
    )

    output = route(findings, _bundle())

    assert [i.check for i in output.issues] == ["H&P", "CONSENT"]
    assert all(i.summary and i.rule == "DOCUMENTATION" for i in output.issues)


def test_rejected_facts_are_surfaced_in_output() -> None:
    rejected = [{"kind": "blood_pressures", "reason": "unknown doc_id", "fact": {}}]

    output = route(ALL_PASS, _bundle(rejected_facts=rejected))

    assert output.rejected_document_facts == rejected
    assert "1 extracted document fact(s) were rejected" in output.explanation


def test_explanation_is_deterministic() -> None:
    findings = _with(_f("TESTING", "CBC", "FAIL", "REQUIRED_TESTING"))

    assert route(findings, _bundle()).explanation == route(findings, _bundle()).explanation
PYEOF
